title: Hiring Intent Interpreter Input
description: Provide a single job or a batch of jobs to analyze for technology buying intent signals.

job_title.title: Job Title
job_title.description: The title of the job posting (used for single-job mode)

job_description.title: Job Description
job_description.description: Full text of the job description (used for single-job mode)
job_description.example: We are looking for an experienced SAP FICO consultant to lead our S/4HANA migration...

company_name.title: Company Name
company_name.description: Name of the hiring company (used for single-job mode)

historical_job_count.title: Historical Job Count
historical_job_count.description: Number of similar roles this company has posted historically (boosts intent score for repeated hiring)

jobs.title: Batch Jobs
jobs.description: Array of job objects for batch processing. Each object should have: job_title, job_description, company_name, historical_job_count

example.job_description: Lead AWS migration of our on-premise data centers...
